scoreUnitByField.fusedScore: reciprocal rank fusion: the sum, over the legs that found the node, of 1 / (60 + rank); comparable only within one result
scoreUnitByField.keywordRank: 1-based rank in the keyword (BM25) leg after the standard filter; null when that leg did not find the node
scoreUnitByField.keywordScore: Lucene BM25 score from the fulltext index: unbounded and relative to this query; null when the keyword leg did not find the node
scoreUnitByField.vectorRank: 1-based rank in the vector leg after the standard filter; null when that leg did not find the node
scoreUnitByField.vectorScore: cosine similarity as Neo4j reports it, (1 + cosine) / 2 in [0, 1]; null when the vector leg did not find the node
scoreUnitByField.foundByLegList: the legs that found the node: 'keyword', 'vector' or both
